key_insight: RLAES uses reinforcement learning plus rubric-based feedback rewards to jointly improve essay scoring and feedback generation, instead of optimizing score prediction alone.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a practical path for building more reliable LLM-based assessment systems with interpretable feedback metrics and controllable post-training objectives.
method: RFE: 166 fine-grained binary rubric items + LLM-as-judge to measure feedback quality.
AGFO: activates rubric-based feedback rewards only when needed to reduce evaluation overhead.
ACR: contrasts adjacent score levels to improve ordinal score calibration.
evidence_signal: On ASAP, RLAES-AGFO achieved QWK = 0.803, with feedback quality comparable to GPT-5.5 and strong alignment with expert preferences.
watch_item: RFE depends on rubric design and LLM-as-judge reliability, so performance may vary across prompts, domains, or annotation standards.
paper_title: Beyond Score Prediction: LLM-Based Essay Scoring and Feedback Generation via Reinforcement Learning with Rubric Rewards
